events.title: Angus & Julia Stone
events.description:
SummerStage Member Presale: Wednesday, November 11 @ 10AM 
 Capital One Cardholder Presale: Wednesday, November 11 @ 10AM 
 General Onsale: Friday, November 13 @ 10AM 
  Aussie sibling duo   Angus & Julia Stone   have been crafting folk and indie-pop hits since forming in 2006. They’re known for their dreamy, ethereal charm and chart-topping albums including    A Book Like This    and    Down the Way   , the latter of which earned them five ARIA awards. Their latest release,    Karaoke Bar   , “captures a sense of both the granular and the grand,” (   Billboard   ) with its joyful message and bright sound.

events.title: Odd Mob
events.description: Known for his genre-defying approach, Australian producer and DJ   Odd Mob   has cemented his place at the forefront of global electronic music. He broke through with the 2014 hit ‘Is It A Banger’; since then, Odd Mob has released a string of hits like ‘LEFT TO RIGHT,’ ‘Get Busy,’ and many more, pushing him past 400+ million streams across platforms.
